title: a tester proof's run-verb ask reaches a tester on its own box
intention: The coverage tooth of test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped asks the tester's run verb of a bus on the same box as its fixture, so the run reads the fixture it names whatever CAIRN_BUS_HOME the session carries.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: the tooth test_the_guard_covers_every_persisting_caller_not_only_the_flag red 'the run verb returned no record': the reply body was {'refused': "no proof file at '/tmp/tmp.../somecomp/proofs/test_thing.py'"}. reach('tester') is a RemoteBus to akiendelllinux.local:7419 (CAIRN_BUS_HOME), so the Dell's tester was asked about akienasus's disk. Red at HEAD too (worktree run). Not a sandbox bind: same mount namespace and /tmp locally.
traces_to: Law 3 - a tooth measures the thing it names, not the route to another box; Law 8 - a proof must be runnable on the box that builds it.
how: Reading 1's ask moves into a child of the proof (--ask-run <path>) under a scratch HOME built by cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.home_env, which drops every CAIRN_BUS_*; the child's reach('tester') lazy-inits a throwaway-table bus under that HOME; the parent shuts that bus down after.

clauses.claim: with the session's CAIRN_BUS_HOME naming another box's bus, the coverage tooth's run-verb ask returns a record for the fixture and the proof is green
no scratch bus process outlives the proof

decisions.text: D1: in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped.py, _ask_run_on_this_box(proof) runs this file with --ask-run under home_env(scratch_dir('testing-42ddfe3b7256-'), PYTHONPATH=repo), parses the reply from the last stdout line, and in finally shuts down RemoteBus(<home>/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/0); _ask_run is the child half; the tooth calls _ask_run_on_this_box instead of reach('tester') in-process.

measured.saw: reply body {'refused': "no proof file at '/tmp/tmpp7vkkzi1/somecomp/proofs/test_thing.py'"}; reach('tester') = RemoteBus _far=('akiendelllinux.local', 7419); red at HEAD in a worktree
measured.how: bin/cairn test cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped.py; python3 -c reach('tester') vars; git worktree at HEAD

measured.saw: ground_loop (pid 24489) and this shell share mnt:[4026531832] and one tmpfs /tmp
after the fix: green twice, no machines.bus process left
measured.how: bin/cairn test x2; ps -eo args | grep machines.bus
